verdict.rationale: Copilot's transparency note documents a memory feature that stores specific facts users ask it to remember and uses them for more relevant responses [copilot-docs-32]. It also says Copilot memory and past research queries feed personalized suggestions [copilot-docs-33]. That is a real first-party cross-session memory capability, but it is described only as user-requested facts, not as automatically pulling relevant context from prior chats into new conversations. missing for 10: documented automatic recall of prior chat history in new conversations, memory management/viewing controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of memory working across chats.
